name: Bloab Rotspawned
canonNotes: Once a tall warrior who tortured small creatures, he was filled by Daemon flies as punishment; now his body is only a skin sack of maggots and he is the swarm.
Nurgle came to favour him and grants him rare access to the Garden.
voiceNotes: Buzzing, unsettling and oddly calm; speaks as many voices of one swarm.
Delights in the small and the crawling; reveres Nurgle's life-in-decay.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
